name: Taiyou no Promia
source:
This is the debut game for Seven Wonder. Kodama stood in the sun-basked streets of Milsant. Even though he looks like any young man, he doesn’t have any memories and there was a baby in his arms who he cannot be separated from. Milsant is ruled by 6 female priests known as the ‘six flowers’. Their powers come from the ‘six large trees’, which were suddenly all surrounded in darkness. He meets Flarerouge, the most powerful of the six girls and servant of the Sun God, and they embark on a journey to recover the light that was lost in the world.

[From [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2011/05/18/may-2011-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
本作是Seven Wonder的出道作。儿玉站在沐浴着阳光的米尔桑特街头。他看起来与普通青年无异，却失去了所有记忆，怀中还抱着一个与自己无法分离的婴儿。米尔桑特由名为‘六花’的6位女神官统治，她们的力量源自‘六棵大树’，然而这些大树突然全部被黑暗笼罩。儿玉遇见六人中最强、侍奉太阳神的芙蕾露珠，随后与她踏上旅程，夺回这个世界失去的光明。

[摘自[url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2011/05/18/may-2011-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
